mcqs.question: Which of the following lists correctly represents the general reactivity series of metals as given in NCERT?

options.A: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > (H) > Cu > Ag > Au
options.B: Na > K > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > (H) > Cu > Ag > Au
options.C: Cu > Ag > Au > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > (H) > K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al
options.D: Au > Ag > Cu > Pb > Sn > Ni > Fe > Zn > Al > Mg > Ca > Na > K > (H)

mcqs.answer: K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > (H) > Cu > Ag > Au
mcqs.explanation: Option A lists the metals in the decreasing order of reactivity as taught in NCERT: potassium, calcium, sodium, magnesium, aluminium, zinc, iron, nickel, tin, lead, hydrogen, copper, silver and gold. All other options either place a less reactive metal before a more reactive one or reverse the whole sequence, making them incorrect.

mcqs.question: A piece of zinc metal is immersed in an aqueous solution of copper(II) sulfate. Which reaction will correctly describe the observed displacement?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc is higher than copper in the reactivity series, so it displaces copper from its salt solution, forming zinc sulfate and metallic copper. Options B and C are not balanced chemical equations, and D is false because a reaction does occur.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: Which statement about the reaction of a metal with a salt solution is NOT correct?

options.A: A metal higher in the reactivity series can displace a metal ion of lower reactivity from its solution.
options.B: A metal lower in the reactivity series can displace a metal ion of higher reactivity from its solution.
options.C: If no visible change occurs, the metal is less reactive than the ion in solution.
options.D: The displaced metal appears as a solid deposit on the surface of the more reactive metal.

mcqs.answer: A metal lower in the reactivity series can displace a metal ion of higher reactivity from its solution.
mcqs.explanation: Only metals that are higher in the reactivity series can displace ions of less reactive metals. Option B reverses this rule, making it the incorrect statement. Options A, C and D correctly describe the displacement process.

mcqs.question: Given the reactivity series K > Ca > Na > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Ni > Sn > Pb > (H) > Cu > Ag > Au, which metal will be able to displace iron from an iron(II) sulfate solution?
mcqs.explanation: Zinc appears above iron in the series, meaning it is more reactive and can displace iron ions from FeSO4 solution. Copper, silver and gold are below iron and therefore cannot displace it.

mcqs.question: Select the pair that is correctly ordered from the more reactive metal to the less reactive metal according to the NCERT reactivity series.
mcqs.explanation: Magnesium is placed above iron in the reactivity series, so Mg is more reactive than Fe, making option A correct. Option B reverses the order, option C places copper (less reactive) before zinc, and option D, while true in absolute terms, does not test the series ordering as required (both are low reactivity but the series lists Au as least reactive).

mcqs.question: Which of the following metals will NOT displace iron from an aqueous solution of iron(III) nitrate?
mcqs.explanation: Copper lies below iron in the reactivity series, so it cannot displace iron ions from Fe(NO3)3 solution. Aluminium, zinc and magnesium are all above iron and can effect displacement. Hence option C is the correct answer.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand reactions of metals with salt solutions
mcqs.question: When a metal that is higher than copper in the reactivity series is placed in copper(II) sulfate solution, what is observed?

options.A: No change; the metal is inert
options.B: The metal dissolves and copper metal precipitates
options.C: Copper metal dissolves and the metal precipitates

mcqs.answer: The metal dissolves and copper metal precipitates
mcqs.explanation: A more reactive metal (e.g., zinc) will lose electrons to copper ions, entering the solution as its own ions while copper ions gain electrons and deposit as solid copper. Hence option B correctly describes the displacement. Options A and D are incorrect, and C reverses the direction of displacement.

mcqs.question: Which metal is more reactive according to the NCERT reactivity series?
mcqs.explanation: Magnesium appears much higher than copper, gold and silver in the reactivity series, indicating it is more reactive. Therefore option C is correct. The other metals are lower in the series and are less reactive.
